CX-02.name: Citizen CX-02 Photo Printer
CX-02.price_confirmation_note: Price subject to confirmation by our sales desk.
CX-02.description:
The Citizen CX02 photo printer is a compact, portable dye sublimation printer built for event photographers, photo booths, and retail kiosks. Lighter than previous CX models, it delivers fast, high-quality prints with excellent color depth. This digital photo printer uses heat-based sublimation to produce durable, lab-quality images on the go. It features ribbon rewind for efficient media use when printing 4×6-inch photos on 6×8-inch paper. Perfect for events, studios, or kiosks, this photo printer ensures reliable and professional performance.
Printing Technology: Dye Sublimation
Printing Resolution: 300 dpi, 600 dpi
Multiple Finishing options: Gloss, Luster, and Matte
Printing Mode: Dual Mode (High Speed and High Quality)
Applications: Event Photo Printer, Photo Booth Printer, and  Studio Photo Printer

CX-02W.name: Citizen CX-02W
CX-02W.price_confirmation_note: Price subject to confirmation by our sales desk.
CX-02W.description:
The Citizen CX-02W printer is a wide-format dye-sub photo printer that delivers pro-quality prints using the same trusted engine as the CX-02. This dye sublimation photo printer supports 8×10 and 8×12-inch sizes, making it ideal for studios and event printing.
